phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Akazi k'igihe gito k'aho iwanyu, nurabe n'umukozi wawe ibijanye n'ibijanye no kurekurwa.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Imigambi yo kuziganya hamwe n'umugambi wo kwitegurira uburaro. Groundwork ntitanga uburaro kandi nta bucuti ifitaniye n'abatanga. Ku bw'imfashanyo yo mu karere, hamagara 211.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.

reentry.call211.draft: Hamagara 211 ku bikoresho vyo mu karere

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Urashobora kandi gufyonda "Urakeneye imfashanyo ubu" hejuru y'imashini iyo ari yo yose.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Nushire ku kirangamisi itariki yose y'urubanza n'aho umuntu yokwinjira

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Nusuzume ibihano vyawe n'amahera utegerezwa kuriha

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Niwiyandikishe kuri Medicaid, kandi niwakenera imfashanyo y'ubwisungane mu kwivuza

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Rondera ahantu hatekanye ho kuba (hamagara 211 canke abafasha mu bijanye n'uburaro)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Rondera ibifungurwa vyo muri iyi ndwi (hamagara 211 canke ikigega c'imfungurwa co mu karere iwanyu)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Umushinga  ⁇  wo gusuzumwa. Intambwe za mbere zitekanye mu masaha 24 ya mbere inyuma y'ugutemba uzoboneka ngaha umaze gusuzumwa.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Ivyandikano vyawe vyanditswe mu buryo bwanditse. Umugambi w'amahera; ntiharashirwaho igiciro.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Si wewe wenyene. Aka kamenyetso k'ingorane kari aho haruguru kaguma aha  ⁇  hamagara canke wandike ubutumwa kuri 988, canke 911 mu bihe vy'ingorane.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Nubaze umukozi wawe ibijanye n'ibijanye n'ukurekurwa ku munyororo imbere y'uko usaba uruhusha.
